name: Robo Storage for Aegis
description: Storage groups for IDrive E2, CloudGate and Linux. A dedicated Aegis dashboard with quotas, users, directory permissions and safe draining.
author: Robo Storage contributors

update_card.tagline: Honor root-domain routing and save the storage ceiling before launch.
highlights: Unchecked tunnel option means root domain, never an automatic prefix
Quota edits after enrollment command generation are saved before Launch
Allocated storage and physical disk capacity are reported separately

settings.label: Direct dashboard password
settings.help: At least 12 characters. Optional for the Aegis mount, which authenticates using an internal secret. Direct access is denied without it.
